content.title: For therapists and professionals
content.intro: Courses, training, supervision and research in trauma therapy from Metiv - The Israel Psychotrauma Center. Here you can find upcoming cohorts, trainings in work with children and families, individual and group supervision, programs for organizations, and studies and publications by Metiv staff.
